test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A shortage of vitamins, minerals, etc. needed for good health
solution: The correct answer is '**Deficiency**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Deficiency**'. • It means **"the lack of something that is needed in order to meet a particular standard or level of quality or the thing that is lacking; a shortage of vitamins, minerals, etc. needed for good health." **(किसी विशेष मानक या गुणवत्ता के स्तर या जो चीज की कमी है उसे पूरा करने के लिए आवश्यक किसी चीज की कमी; अच्छे स्वास्थ्य के लिए आवश्यक विटामिन, खनिजों आदि की कमी) • *Example: a deficiency of **vitamin C...*** **Correct Answer:__** *Deficiency.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Nutrition**: the food that you eat and the way that it affects your health. (स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य को पुष्‍ट करने वाला भोजन, पोषाहार) • **Defect**: something that is wrong with or missing from somebody/something. (दोष, ख़राबी या त्रुटि) • **Disease**: an illness of the body in humans, animals, or plants. [रोग] 38:Td0d, The correct answer is '**Opening**'.
